# Centro Empresarial Yolanda Rico (São Clemente 258)

> Entire office building for sale at Rua São Clemente, 258, Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Also known as Centro Empresarial São Clemente 258, Edifício São Clemente 258. Site area 2,055 m² (RGI), ≈8,100 m² built area, 8 corporate floors of ≈425 m², ground-floor retail unit of ≈390 m², 125 parking spaces. Sold as a whole by its family owners. Price on request.

Contact: Susana Estevez Rico · sclem258@gmail.com · WhatsApp +34 666 453 107
